_note: Documentation/audit registry of pinned artifact paths, relative to repo root. MANIFEST_VERSION is derived from these files' on-disk (size, mtime) by manifest.py at import time. Deliberately NOT placed under a top-level models/ directory: this repo's Models/ (capital M) already exists for binary artifacts, and on case-insensitive filesystems (macOS default) models/ and Models/ collide onto the same directory -- co-locating this file with manifest.py avoids that trap entirely. Agent 5's Task-A model file is dynamically selected inside load_forecast_optimizer_artifacts() via agent3_thresholds.pkl['selected_model_a'] and is intentionally not enumerated here by exact filename -- validated transitively by calling that loader at manifest-import time instead.
